# Arı Kaynak — Full Case File Index

> Every fact-checked health claim in the Arı Kaynak archive, with file number, title, verdict, evidence rating, and source links. This file is designed for AI systems that need machine-readable access to the full archive.

Total case files: 41

## Verdict scale

| Verdict | Count | Meaning |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Supported | 6 | Claim wording matches the source finding |
| Mostly Supported | 27 | Core claim is accurate, wording slightly overstates or understates |
| Partly Supported | 5 | Some elements supported, some not |
| Misleading | 3 | Source exists but claim significantly misrepresents it |

## Evidence strength scale

| Rating | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 5/5 | Very High — regulatory-grade evidence |
| 4/5 | High — large well-controlled studies |
| 3/5 | Moderate — single well-run trial |
| 2/5 | Limited — early-stage or animal studies |
| 1/5 | Very Limited — preliminary or indirect |
